option.name: originalContent
option.value:
spring.application.name=api-gateway
# Enable discovery for Gateway spring.cloud.gateway.discovery.locator.enabled=true spring.cloud.gateway.discovery.locator.lower-case-service-id=true
# Route 0: User Service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].id=user-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].uri=lb://user-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].predicates[0]=Path=/api/users/**
# Route 1: AI Service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].id=ai-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].uri=lb://ai-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].predicates[0]=Path=/api/ai/**
# Route 2: Activity Service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].id=activity-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].uri=lb://activity-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].predicates[0]=Path=/api/activities/**
server.port=8080
# Eureka connection eureka.client.serviceUrl.defaultZone=http://localhost:8761/eureka/
# oauth configuration spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.jwk-set-uri=http://localhost:8181/realms/fitness-oAuth2/protocol/openid-connect/certs
# Debug logs for route matching and forwarding logging.level.org.springframework.cloud.gateway=DEBUG logging.level.org.springframework.web.reactive.DispatcherHandler=DEBUG logging.level.reactor.netty.http.client=DEBUG
# Expose gateway actuator endpoints for route inspection management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,gateway management.endpoint.gateway.enabled=true management.endpoint.health.show-details=always

# client connection with the config server spring.config.import=optional:configserver:http://localhost:8888
# local fallback routes (used if config server is unavailable) spring.cloud.gateway.discovery.locator.enabled=true spring.cloud.gateway.discovery.locator.lower-case-service-id=true spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].id=user-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].uri=lb://user-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].predicates[0]=Path=/api/users/** spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].id=ai-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].uri=lb://ai-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].predicates[0]=Path=/api/ai/** spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].id=activity-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].uri=lb://activity-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].predicates[0]=Path=/api/activities/**

# local fallback for resource-server JWT decoder (overridden by config server if provided) spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.jwk-set-uri=http://localhost:8181/realms/fitness-oAuth2/protocol/openid-connect/certs
# Debug logs for route matching and forwarding logging.level.org.springframework.cloud.gateway=DEBUG logging.level.org.springframework.web.reactive.DispatcherHandler=DEBUG logging.level.reactor.netty.http.client=DEBUG
# Expose gateway actuator endpoints for route inspection management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,gateway management.endpoint.gateway.enabled=true management.endpoint.health.show-details=always
